name: Ingratitude To God
overview: Scripture warns against forgetting the Lord and failing to keep His commandments, especially when experiencing abundance and prosperity, as seen in Deuteronomy 8:11-14. The passage cautions that a heart lifted up in pride can lead to ingratitude toward God, who delivered His people from bondage. Additionally, 1 Samuel 15:17-18 highlights the importance of recognizing God's sovereign appointments and commands, reminding us that ingratitude can manifest in disobedience despite God’s clear guidance and blessings.
